set-variable.value: #[do { var h = attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default '' --- if (h matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/) h else correlationId }]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.start", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.success", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId, propertyCode: payload.meta.property_code, totalResults: payload.meta.total_results, elapsedMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - vars.startedAt}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-variable.value: Request body must be valid JSON.

raise-error.description: Request body is not valid JSON
